data.name: Berserker Girl
data.detailed_description:
What Is “Berserker Girl”?

This is a fast-paced 3D hack-and-slash action game
where a superhuman girl goes berserk against countless enemies.

Built with Unreal Engine 5, the game features stunning and dynamic battlefields
where players use stylish parkour moves to tear through swarms of foes.

“Dodge. Charge. Annihilate.”
Just these three simple elements create the ultimate sense of exhilaration.

Developed as a spiritual successor to the jump-action game “JUMP de PON,”
this title offers larger environments and more vertical, dynamic combat.
Run, jump, wall-run, and unleash your Berserker Gauge!

Game Features

◆ Wipe Out Enemies with the Berserker Gauge!
Defeating enemies charges your Berserker Gauge.
Once it’s full, unleash the powerful Berserker Attack,
a devastating move that wipes out every enemy on screen in an instant.

Amid flashes and explosions that consume the horde,
you’ll become a true Berserker.

◆ Parkour × TPS = The Fusion of Speed and Freedom
Each third-person (TPS) stage is designed as a fully explorable 3D arena.
It’s not just about shooting —
movement itself becomes the core of combat,
delivering an intense sense of freedom and flow.

◆ Simple Controls, Deep Combat
With only three basic actions — attack, move, and jump —
anyone can pick up and play.

Yet, precise timing and sharp judgment
can completely change the course of battle.

Its tight controls and satisfying feedback
create an addictive rhythm, almost like a rhythm-action game.

◆ Character Unlocks and Growth
Collect currency from item boxes as rewards.
Use your savings to unlock new playable characters,
each with unique abilities and action styles.

Train your favorites and aim to reach the next level of “musou” dominance!

World

The story unfolds in the ruins of an ancient, desolate civilization.

Amidst a world overrun by grotesque monsters —
hybrids of machine and flesh —
the last human warrior, Neki, throws herself into an endless battle.

Is her purpose revenge... or atonement?

As she races across the battlefield like a raging storm,
beauty and destruction intertwine —
and a fleeting yet fierce struggle begins.


Dodge, charge, and annihilate.
In that moment, you become “Musou Neki.”
